note: ESPEN practical guideline: Clinical Nutrition in cancer, 2021. The corpus's principal nutrition authority, and the anchor of a tranche that had no source at all before today -- `nutrition` was a role with nothing behind it while `fact_schema` extracted MNA, albumin and protein from every dossier.

default.note: Screening, requirements, oral and enteral and parenteral support, and the interventions that go with surgery, radiotherapy and systemic treatment. None of it is about a disease stage, and all of it is about a patient at any stage. Serves supportive_care throughout: Nutritional care during cancer treatment, which accompanies every disease setting.

rules.note: Leaf-matched and every occurrence: the conversion files the reference list under whichever chapter happens to be last, so its path is not predictable but its own heading is.
